headline: Coffee Sector Alarmed by Proposed VAT Hike in Colombia's Fiscal Bill
summary: A proposal by the Colombian government to raise the value-added tax on coffee from 5% to 19% under a fiscal bill has sparked concern among coffee growers over potential impacts on domestic consumption and producer revenue.
why: Colombia is a leading global coffee producer; tax policy changes affecting agricultural commodities can alter domestic supply chains, consumer demand, and export competitiveness.

impacts.name: Coffee producers
impacts.why: Higher consumer VAT on coffee threatens to reduce domestic consumption volumes and pressure agricultural revenues.
